[RLOW.5.4.1] `now()` lowers to the `now` expression
(`proto/rete_expr.proto#Expr`), which reads the wall clock's held sample.
`monotonic_ns()` lowers to a call of `FN_MONOTONIC_NS`, which reads the
monotonic clock's ([IRET.14]). Every relative-time test the
compiler generates, the `within` window above included, reads `monotonic_ns()`
and never `now()` ([LTIM.2.8.3]).
